verdict.rationale: Convex's first-party docs describe built-in vector search that finds Convex documents similar to a provided vector, typically embeddings, with filter fields indexed inside a vector index. The pricing page lists vector search on the Free & Starter plans. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation of embedding storage details (vector field types, dimensions, limits), and depth on query and ranking behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search for AI features

citations.quote: Vector search allows you to find Convex documents similar to a provided vector. Typically, vectors will be embeddings which are numerical representations of text, images, or audio.
Embeddings and vector search enable you to provide useful context to LLMs for AI powered applications, recommendations for similar content and more.
The names of additional fields that are indexed for fast filtering within your vector index.
